stepBody:
Suppose after training our model we get
$$ eta=(-1.2, -0.005, 2.5)$$
where $$-1.2$$ is an intercept term, $$-0.005$$ is the parameter corresponding to passenger's age, and $$2.5$$ is the parameter corresponding to sex.
Let $$m$$ be the odds of a given male passenger's survival according to our model, i.e. if the passenger had an $$80$$ percent chance of survival, $$m$$ would be $$4$$, since their odds of survival are $$0.8$$ divided by $$0.2$$, which is $$4$$. It turns out we can compute $$f, $$ the odds of survival for a female of the same age, even if we don't know the age of the two people. What is this relationship?
